mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO recommend_impression_log (tenant_id, user_id, product_id, scene, position, bucket, create_time) VALUES
(#{it.tenantId}, #{it.userId}, #{it.productId}, #{it.scene}, #{it.position}, #{it.bucket}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT DATE(i.create_time) AS statDate, i.bucket AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(DISTINCT i.user_id) AS uv, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL THEN i.id END) AS clicks FROM recommend_impression_log i LEFT JOIN product_view_log v ON v.product_id = i.product_id AND v.user_id = i.user_id AND v.view_time >= i.create_time AND v.view_time < DATE_ADD(i.create_time, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) WHERE i.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE(i.create_time), i.bucket ORDER BY statDate DESC, bucket ASC

SELECT i.product_id AS productId, p.title, p.cover, COUNT(*) AS impressions, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN v.id IS NOT NULL THEN i.id END) AS clicks FROM recommend_impression_log i LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id LEFT JOIN product_view_log v ON v.product_id = i.product_id AND v.user_id = i.user_id AND v.view_time >= i.create_time AND v.view_time < DATE_ADD(i.create_time, INTERVAL 30 MINUTE) WHERE i.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND i.bucket = #{bucket} GROUP BY i.product_id, p.title, p.cover ORDER BY clicks DESC, impressions DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recommend_impression_log WHERE create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
